verification.method: 203 broad development and 34 production cases pass on final product source. Earlier focused cases repeat within broad and are not counted twice. Actual native WASM and real Chromium decode/render/download paths are used; no provider or mock decoder substitutes for output pixels.

contract.scope: Within each isolated visible sibling list, render only the prefix through the last visible nonzero-opacity adjustment or enabled Blend If; preserve later siblings and outer parent settings. A parent Blend If itself needs its actual preceding sibling backdrop.
contract.editability: Native prefixes preserve rendered appearance, not editable internal paths/text/paint/adjustment/mask/style/Blend If graphs. Capability reports list stack endings and clipped off-support data. Projects retain all original data.
contract.workingFrame: Compose parent/output-origin matrices into original sibling roots directly. Preserve logical layer/depth counts, root-scope unlinked mask/filter-mask rebasing and retained smart-master coordinates. Clear private maps/support and layer comps from native frames; retain original component definitions.
contract.lifetime: Pin visible raster, clone, patch and bitmap-mask dependencies before the first callback; referenced fonts pin at font-preparation start before measurement/native rendering. Check sources/fonts around native work and cooperative encoding callbacks, release surfaces, and publish no partial result on stale/cancelled/failed work.
contract.standalone: Synchronous VectorLayer.toSvg rejects enabled Blend If with a host native-backdrop-preparation error. Hidden/zero-opacity output remains empty. No new public mutation/schema/REST renderer/script/plugin capability.

appearanceSummary.independentChecks: Known exposed RGB after +1 exposure, conditional overlays fully rejected by source/underlying gates, unchanged isolated backdrop outside its group, exact later green/red paths, opaque transformed master interiors, source/clip contours plus shifted three-blur-radius shadow support, zero fully opaque/transparent holes, coverage area within 0.1% and centroid within 0.05 pixels of native reference.

diagnostics: Initial 41-case run passes 40 and fails the unfiltered transformed master at maximum alpha/premultiplied error 12. Master-clip/shadow/inset variants isolate larger errors to transformed source/clip edges and propagated shadows; a pure blanket three-byte limit was insufficient.

Original and no-shadow variants differ by up to 12 alpha/premultiplied units; inset shape/shadow reaches 16 alpha / 30.28235294117647 premultiplied. All independent interior/geometry/coverage checks pass; filtered native prefix is byte-exact. Detailed maxima/means/area/centroid/contour diagnostics are retained. Product keeps editable parent geometry; no blanket fidelity or per-stage causal rounding proof is claimed.

Native frame construction was changed from an extra wrapper to direct sibling-root rebasing before final focused/build/unit/broad/production checks, preserving the original logical layer/depth budget.

genuine50MP.scope: Actual 10000x5000 import/save/reopen; all original source bytes preserved. Native prefix uses 395 bounded released render tiles; full 50 MP embedded PNG is actually decoded and six native-coordinate expected samples inspected. Four 8x8 decoded SVG crops agree with native readback, including later editable green geometry. This does not prove a full 50 MP composite SVG raster decode or whole-process peak memory.

separateFullPngWorkflow.note: Existing genuine 50 MP import/WASM edit/save/reopen/full-resolution PNG test; single observation during broad run, not a controlled speed benchmark.

limitations: Internal prefix artwork/settings and off-support pixels lose SVG editability; editable SVG adjustment graphs, shared symbols/master identity and general SVG import/round-trip remain open.
Prepared native/SVG hierarchy output has measured transformed-edge differences. Exact geometry and native kernels do not guarantee universal byte parity across working origins/viewers.

PNG/base64 output, resident decoded sources and viewer/filter allocations consume memory; native prefixes currently cover conservative full document/shadow support. No arbitrary import-resolution cap or destructive original-source resampling.
No p95/input-to-photon, long-task, peak-memory, hardware GPU or universal performance/fidelity claim.
